products.name: Q-Bic Plus
products.generic: a modular infiltration and retention system

evidence.quote: A new JANSEN Q-Bic Plus infiltration and rainwater management system was installed for Opernhaus Zurich’s Kügeliloo warehouse on behalf of the city authorities.
It took only two days to install the retention system with its 550 basket elements.
JANSEN powerwave single-u ground source heat loops were used in order to achieve the required heat output from fewer and shorter boreholes.
The extremely slimline Janisol Arte profile system – it has profile face widths of just 25 to 40 millimetres
